rows.name: SoFIE-GEL
rows.notes: Flames spread over PMMA at oxygen concentrations as low as ~15% in quiescent microgravity — below typical Earth extinction limits (~17–18%).
rows.objectives: Map the ignition and extinction boundaries of flame spread over flat solid fuels in sustained microgravity.; Test whether materials qualified as low-flammability on Earth remain non-propagating in µg.
rows.apparatus: CIR flat solid-fuel holder — thin PMMA sheets in an opposed-flow duct
rows.sensors: video flame imaging; radiometers; flame-spread position tracking
rows.test_variables: held: flat PMMA sheet geometry; ambient pressure ~101 kPa | varied: O2 15–24%; opposed flow 0–25 cm/s

rows.name: BASS-II
rows.fuel_or_material: PMMA spheres, cotton fabric, Nomex, polycarbonate
rows.notes: Characterized opposed-flow flame spread and extinction over small solid samples across oxygen and flow regimes.
rows.objectives: Measure opposed-flow flame spread and extinction over small solid samples across O2 and ventilation regimes.; Characterize µg-unique transitions: steady burn → abrupt extinction → smolder.
rows.apparatus: MSG modular flow duct with fan — spheres, slabs and sheets on a sample holder
rows.sensors: video flame imaging; radiometers; thermocouples; O2/CO2 gas analyzers
rows.test_variables: held: MSG duct rig; ambient pressure | varied: fuel (PMMA, cotton, Nomex, polycarbonate); sample form/size (1–2 cm spheres, slabs, sheets); O2 17–40%; duct flow 0–20 cm/s

rows.name: FLEX / FLEX-2
rows.notes: Discovered sustained 'cool flame' chemistry: droplets kept burning invisibly at ~600 K long after the visible hot flame extinguished.
rows.objectives: Map flammability limits of isolated fuel droplets and quantify gaseous suppressant effectiveness — CO2, He and N2 dilution.; Measure droplet burning rates, extinction diameters and post-flameout cool-flame chemistry in quiescent µg.
rows.apparatus: CIR Multi-user Droplet Combustion Apparatus (MDCA) — free-floating ~1–4 mm droplets
rows.sensors: backlit droplet imaging (LLUV); UV/visible flame cameras; radiometers
rows.test_variables: held: free droplet geometry; ambient pressure ~1 atm | varied: fuel (n-heptane, methanol, dodecane, iso-octane); O2 14–25%; diluent species & fraction (N2 / CO2 / He); droplet d₀

rows.name: ACME
rows.notes: Mapped soot inception and growth in laminar coflow diffusion flames without buoyancy-driven distortion.
rows.objectives: Measure structure, soot inception and extinction of laminar coflow diffusion flames without buoyant distortion.; Emulate solid-fuel burning rates with a gas burner (BRE) to enable ground-based flammability testing.
rows.apparatus: CIR coflow burner — gaseous fuel jet in coflowing oxidizer (E-FIELD adds high-voltage mesh electrodes)
rows.sensors: color/UV flame imaging; laser soot diagnostics; ion probes; thermocouples
rows.test_variables: held: coflow burner geometry | varied: fuel (CH4, C2H4, C3H8, JP-8 surrogates); O2 16–40%; coflow velocity 0–70 cm/s; fuel dilution; E-FIELD voltage & polarity

rows.name: Saffire I–VI
rows.fuel_or_material: SIBAL cloth (cotton/fiberglass), Nomex, PMMA, structured material panels
rows.notes: Largest deliberate fires ever set in an uncrewed spacecraft — flame behavior at ~meter scale differs from small CIR samples.
rows.objectives: Observe a realistic large-scale fire inside an uncrewed cargo vehicle after departure from the ISS.; Measure flame spread, material flammability, O2 draw-down and CO/CO2 production at vehicle scale.
rows.apparatus: Cygnus pressurized volume — instrumented flow duct and large material panels
rows.sensors: video flame imaging; O2/CO/CO2 gas analyzers; temperature & pressure loggers; post-fire aerosol sampling
rows.test_variables: held: uncrewed vehicle post-departure; ducted flow path | varied: material (SIBAL, Nomex, PMMA panels); O2 21–34%; flow 5–25 cm/s; vehicle (OA-6 → later flights)

rows.name: SAME
rows.fuel_or_material: Teflon, Kapton, Pyrell foam, silicone rubber, cellulose
rows.notes: Measured particle size distribution of smoke from overheated and ignited spacecraft materials.
rows.objectives: Measure the size distribution and concentration of smoke particles from overheated and ignited spacecraft materials.; Benchmark real smoke-detector response against reference aerosol instruments in µg.
rows.apparatus: MSG sealed aerosol chamber — heated material samples on a carousel
rows.sensors: aerosol moment instruments (number/diameter/mass concentration); thermal precipitator → TEM microscopy; ISS/Shuttle ionization & photoelectric detectors
rows.test_variables: held: sealed aerosol chamber; aerosol instrument stack | varied: material (Teflon, Kapton, Pyrell foam, silicone rubber, cellulose); overheated vs ignited regime; smoke aging time

rows.name: Confined Combustion
rows.notes: Flame spread between close parallel plates (confined geometry, like racks/ducts) is strongly affected by wall heat recirculation.
rows.objectives: Quantify how confinement — parallel plates, rack and duct gaps — changes flame spread versus open µg tests.; Measure spread under exploration-like atmospheres: reduced pressure with elevated O2 fraction.
rows.apparatus: CIR confined-channel rig — twin parallel plates with adjustable gap
rows.test_variables: held: confined-channel geometry per run | varied: gap width; O2 19–40%; pressure ~57 kPa; fuel (thin paper/PP sheets, PMMA)

rows.name: FLARE
rows.notes: Directly maps material flammability limits at Lunar (0.17 g) and Martian (0.38 g) gravity using an on-orbit centrifuge.
rows.objectives: Map material flammability limits directly at lunar (0.17 g) and martian (0.38 g) gravity.; Provide the partial-g data anchor that ISS and Earth results cannot interpolate.
rows.apparatus: Kibo module combustion cell mounted on a centrifuge — selectable g level
rows.sensors: flame imaging; flame-spread tracking; controlled O2/flow loop
rows.test_variables: held: sample set (PMMA, thin sheets); centrifuge rig | varied: gravity level (µg / 0.17 g / 0.38 g / 1 g); O2 15–40%; flow 0–30 cm/s

rows.name: BASS
rows.fuel_or_material: PMMA spheres (1–2 cm), SIBAL cloth, Nomex blends, wax slabs and candles, Ultem sheets
rows.notes: Showed that sample geometry and form factor — sphere diameter, sheet thickness, candle vs slab — shift extinction boundaries in µg even when the polymer is unchanged.
rows.objectives: Quantify burning and extinction behavior of solid fuels in opposed and concurrent forced flow inside the MSG duct.; Isolate the effect of sample geometry and size on µg flammability limits.
rows.apparatus: MSG modular flow duct with fan — spheres, slabs, sheets and candles on a sample tree
rows.sensors: video flame imaging; radiometers; thermocouples; flow velocity probes
rows.test_variables: held: MSG duct rig; ambient pressure | varied: fuel and form factor (1–2 cm spheres, slabs, sheets, candles); flow direction (opposed vs concurrent); O2 atmosphere

rows.name: SAME-R
rows.fuel_or_material: Teflon, Kapton, Pyrell foam, silicone rubber, cellulose
rows.notes: Reflew the SAME diagnostic stack on the SAME flight hardware to extend µg smoke-particle statistics and validate the lognormal size-distribution assumption used by the moment method.
rows.objectives: Extend SAME smoke-aerosol measurements to additional materials and longer smoke aging.; Validate detector-response models required for next-generation spacecraft smoke detectors.
rows.apparatus: SAME hardware reflight — sealed aerosol chamber with sample carousel
rows.sensors: aerosol moment instruments; ionization smoke detector (SAME heritage); thermal precipitator → TEM; reference photometers
rows.test_variables: held: SAME hardware stack; sealed aerosol chamber | varied: target material; smoke aging time

rows.name: SPICE
rows.notes: Determined laminar smoke points — the largest soot-free flame — for non-buoyant gas-jet flames.
rows.objectives: Measure smoke-point properties of non-buoyant jet diffusion flames across fuels and nozzle/coflow configurations.; Provide soot-inception data to validate combustion and fire-spread models.
rows.apparatus: MSG enclosed coflow burner — gas jet inside a coaxial oxidizer stream
rows.sensors: still/video flame imaging; smoke-point onset determination; coflow velocity control
rows.test_variables: held: enclosed coflow burner | varied: fuel; nozzle diameter; coflow velocity

rows.name: SLICE
rows.notes: Captured a unique coflow-jet dataset spanning weak near-extinction flames to strong heavily-sooting flames.
rows.objectives: Determine laminar diffusion flame structure and liftoff (stabilization) limits as functions of fuel and burner diameter.; Provide a validation dataset for combustion models including radiation, soot and detailed kinetics.
rows.apparatus: MSG coflow burner (SPICE heritage) — fuel jet in coflowing air
rows.sensors: color digital flame imaging; thermocouple-calibrated soot volume fraction; CH* chemiluminescence
rows.test_variables: held: burner and coflow geometry | varied: fuel (methane vs ethylene vs N2-diluted); jet velocity → liftoff boundary

rows.name: ACME E-FIELD Flames
rows.notes: Applied electric fields to flame ions — the resulting ion wind mimics buoyant convection, giving a controllable body-force 'gravity knob' between 0g and 1g behavior.
rows.objectives: Quantify how electric fields modify laminar flame structure, soot and extinction via ion wind.; Use the field as a controllable body-force analog to interpolate flame behavior between 0g and 1g.
rows.apparatus: CIR coflow burner with high-voltage mesh electrodes around the flame
rows.sensors: flame imaging; mesh polarity/voltage logs; soot diagnostics
rows.test_variables: held: coflow burner + electrode geometry | varied: fuel (CH4, C2H4 and dilutions); field polarity; voltage magnitude

rows.name: ACME CFI / CFI-G
rows.fuel_or_material: ethane, propane, butane, diluted alkane feeds
rows.notes: Largest single corpus in this dataset — 333 PSI-159 runs mapping the boundary between no-ignition, oxygen-limit extinction and sustained burnout for gaseous alkanes.
rows.objectives: Map ignition, extinction and cool-flame boundaries of gaseous alkane flames in a spherical burner.; Quantify the effect of fuel dilution on flammability limits at elevated O2.
rows.apparatus: CIR spherical gaseous burner — ignition at the center of a quiescent chamber
rows.sensors: flame imaging; ignition logs; chamber pressure/temperature
rows.test_variables: held: spherical burner geometry; ambient pressure | varied: fuel (ethane, propane, butane); fuel dilution (30–100%); O2 ~21–39%
